contentHtml:
Road accidents can be dangerous and stressful, and no one intends to cause them. However, some people are caught up in an automobile accident in the UAE. Even mild accidents can cause shock. For this reason, various reliable insurance companies offer a comprehensive selection of insurance options for people, providing some useful suggestions to assist people in handling the consequences of a road accident.

Road accidents may occur in various conditions and may be caused by driving mistakes. These car accidents can create extremely daunting situations, panic, and uncertain conditions, which incur negative consequences, and people need to take immediate action to protect themselves.

Preventive Measures to Avoid Car Accidents:

While accidents are sometimes unavoidable, practicing safe driving can reduce the risks.

  • Always maintain a safe distance on highways.
  • Avoid distracted driving (mobile phone use, eating while driving).
  • Stick to lane discipline and follow speed limits strictly.
  • Regularly service your vehicle to prevent mechanical failures.

What to Do in Case of a Car Accident in Dubai?

The Dubai government guarantees the security of all through entities such as the Dubai Police. The police are in charge of enforcing traffic laws and ensuring road safety. Despite safeguards, accidents can occur unintentionally.
Submitting a road accident report is required in the context of an extensive or minor road accident. It protects drivers from prosecution and is required for car maintenance. Below is a simple procedure for filing a car accident in Dubai:

Avoid Panic And Consider The Extent Of The Situation

Stop worrying about avoiding future issues. Step out of the car and inspect it for any serious injuries to passengers or vehicle harm. If the collision is modest, move the vehicle to a safe spot to prevent traffic congestion.
Avoid driving in significant accidents, call an ambulance if there are serious injuries, and notify the police right away.

Notify the Dubai Police after a Car Accident

The following step is to contact the police and fill out a Dubai car accident report. Below is how you can easily report a road accident:

For Serious Mishaps

Significant crashes are defined as those that include substantial injuries or dangerous collisions. In such cases, turn off the engine and step out of the car. Then contact the emergency and police to inform them about the accident. As a result, if you need immediate medical assistance, contact an ambulance.

An emergency crew will arrive at the scene and begin conducting an inquiry. The police will also inspect the driver’s license, Emirates ID, and vehicle registration card. Following an investigation, the police will provide an accident report and a slip. Based on the findings, a slip is provided to individuals. 

For Slight Mishaps

There is no need to call the emergency number for minor incidents, such as automobile scrapes, that do not result in serious injuries. Instead, drive to the scene and report the collision using the Dubai Police website or a smartphone app.
Those who wish to apply in person can do so at their nearest police station. Furthermore, the driver must not be under the effects of alcohol, as there is no mercy for this offense.

Through the Online Site 

Dubai Police has acted quickly by launching an online service. Steps to Report a Dubai Car Accident Online: 

  • Visit the Dubai Police official website or the Android app
  • Tap on Services from the Menu.
  • Navigate to Road Accident Report under Traffic Services.
  • Activate your GPS location.
  • Provide the number of automobiles involved in the incident.
  • Please include the vehicle’s registration plate and license number.
  • Submit images of damaged automobiles and do the same for all affected vehicles.
  • To obtain the accident report, provide your mobile number and email address below.
  • Pay service charges with a chosen online payment method.
  • The report will be given within 24 hours following the conclusion of the inquiry. 

Through the Dubai Police Station 

Drivers can also register a report at their nearby police station for a car accident in Dubai. When the interested parties have opposing viewpoints, contacting a police station is the best alternative. Go to the police station, register a report, pay the service costs, and get an accident report immediately. Here is the Dubai Police’s contact information for any inquiries:

Obtain The Road Accident Report And Release The Vehicle

Once the police have issued a car accident report in Dubai, a driver may take their vehicle to a workshop. Remember that an accident report serves as documentation and is required for car repairs. 

It is essential to be aware that the road accident report remains effective for three months from the date of issuance. It also suggests that all repairs must be performed within this time range to avoid complications.

Filing An Unknown Road Accident

Road accidents may happen anywhere and at any moment; for example, someone could hit a standing automobile in a parking lot. In such cases, the automobile owner may be ignorant of the individual responsible. So, there is no need to worry since drivers may report such accidents. Filing a report is required when fixing a damaged car. 

You can utilize the Dubai Police website or smartphone app, or go to the nearest police station. Take photographs of all sides of the automobile and pay the service fees.

Updates On The Application

The Dubai Police website allows car owners and drivers to check on the status of their car accident reports. Drivers may also use this service by visiting Smart Police Stations across Dubai. It is accessible to everyone, and anybody may quickly check the status by entering the application’s code number. Follow these steps to see the status quickly:

  • Head over to the Dubai Police’s website.
  • Navigate to Application Status in the Services category.
  • Enter the Reference Code
  • Choose Vehicle Accident.
  • To check the status, tap the submit button. 

Dos and Don’ts at the Car Accident Scene in Dubai

While we have a lot of knowledge on what to do following an automobile accident, many individuals are unaware of what to avoid. Let’s take a closer look at what the things are to avoid in case of road accidents in the UAE, from not panicking and contacting the police and a car accident attorney: 

Getaway from the Road Accident Scene

The most crucial thing you need to avoid after an automobile accident is to leave the area. Whether you were in a car accident in Dubai with your rental car or your vehicle, you must examine the other driver, no matter how minor the collision was. You have to share information with the opposing side, particularly if there is property damage or casualties. You should notify the law enforcement agency. In the worst-case scenario, skipping accident scenes might result in significant penalties or incarceration. 

Lack of Your Control

The most obvious step is to avoid panic and losing your calmness. Feeling worried or furious is a natural reaction after a vehicle accident. However, you should never give up your traumatic feelings since the other party may want your assistance. Even if another person caused the accident, determine whether they require medical attention. Remain cool, take deep breaths, and restore your concentration. This will put you in a better frame of mind to analyze the situation, estimate the damage, and complete the required documents.

Avoid Calling The Police

No vehicle accident in the UAE should remain unreported. Make sure you contact the police as soon as possible to file the report. If a police officer fails to arrive or is late, you must collect evidence and the car accident history to ensure that all information is documented. If there is no proof, information will be minimal, leaving the possibility for arguments. Even worse, the tales can change. 

As a result, it is important to contact the police so that a filed report can help expedite the claim procedure for long-term injuries or automotive repair and maintenance. Make sure to tell them the location, advise them about the occurrence, and follow the police’s directions. 

Not Collecting An Adequate Police Report

As previously said, having a comprehensive police report is critical following an automobile accident. Without a comprehensive police record, you might face significant legal and financial consequences. Accident repairs without a police record are not permitted. If an accident is filed via the Dubai Police app, all affected parties get automobile accident reports by SMS within 24 hours.

Refusing Injury

Although you’re feeling fine after the road accident, this does not always imply that you are not wounded. The body had minor injuries for an initial few hours, but if not treated well or tackled, your condition can get worse over time. One of the most common blunders following a vehicle accident is denying that you were injured.

Furthermore, claiming that you are not wounded may disqualify you from getting personal injury compensation from the at-fault party. In the event of a Dubai car accident, you may lose access to delayed medical treatment. As a result, ensure that you are inspected as soon as possible to determine any internal injuries caused by the accident and receive appropriate medical care. 

Not Consulting a Car Accident Attorney

There is no argument that serious vehicle accidents may be frustrating and stressful. As a result, you must contact a vehicle accident attorney in the UAE to handle your case. They can also interact with insurance providers and assist you as needed.

Medical & Emergency Care After a Car Accident

Even if you feel fine, it is advised to get checked after a Dubai car accident.

  • Call 998 for ambulance services.
  • Visit the nearest hospital or trauma center for medical assessment.
  • Keep hospital reports safe, as they may be required for insurance or legal claims.

Legal Consequences of Failing to Report Accidents

Failing to report an accident in Dubai is a serious offense.

  • Fleeing the scene (Hit and Run): Fine of AED 25,000 and up to jail time.
  • Driving under the influence (DUI): Heavy fines, license suspension, and possible imprisonment.
  • Not filing a police report: Insurance claims will be rejected, and you may face fines.

Conclusion

Driving on Dubai’s well-kept roads is a joyful experience. However, you must be extra cautious; driving safely is the best approach to prevent car accidents in Dubai. When a car incident occurs, remain calm and controlled, assess the situation, and contact the police. You may also use the Dubai Police Android app to notify them about the collision, leave the scene, and secure yourself. If you’re in good health, consider safeguarding other drivers and passengers as a better option. For more info, contact us..

FAQs for Car Accident

Can I Receive a Road Accident Report Online?

To register a report, go to the official Dubai Police web portal or smartphone app. The only information necessary is the car registration number and the driver’s license number. The report will be provided to you within 24 hours of the investigation’s completion.

Can I report an Unknown Road Accident?

Drivers may additionally report an unknown collision and get an accident report. They can apply online or using a smartphone app, or they can go to their nearest police station in Dubai. 

Can we report a minor collision in Dubai?

Drivers must report all accidents to the Dubai Police. Otherwise, they will have problems having the repairs completed. However, reporting minor automobile accidents in Dubai has become considerably easier, with drivers being able to do so using the convenient Dubai Police app rather than contacting the police.

What kind of data must be provided when reporting a road accident?

To report a collision in Dubai, you’ll need your driver’s license number and vehicle registration number.

Do I need to pay any additional charges?

Yes, the person who caused the accident has to pay the filing costs. These costs can be paid in cash or through a debit card.
